title: Navimower 0.5.0-beta19

## Issue #437: startup/departure position trust gate

This beta addresses the remaining mower-marker jump from #437.

The phantom straight trail was already fixed by the retained-trail polygon guard.
The remaining issue was different: the first MQTT type-1 pose received after
startup could be an old/cached vendor pose, but the integration marked it fresh
from its Home Assistant arrival time. That allowed a stale old position to win
for a few seconds until a genuinely current pose arrived.

### Trust real poses; never synthesize station XY

beta19 adds a stateful trust gate before Canonical PositionResolver publishes a
pose.

At startup:

- a docked mower with known map-station geometry accepts a real MQTT/cloud pose
  only when its actual XY is within 2 m of the station;
- station XY is used only as validation evidence and is never substituted for
  the mower position;
- therefore the real pose heading is preserved;
- if all startup candidates are inconsistent, public position is unavailable
  and the Map Card hides the mower marker until a trustworthy real pose arrives;
- when no station is available, a recent vendor source timestamp is accepted;
  old firmware without source timestamps has a conservative repeated-pose /
  timeout fallback.

For a mower that was trusted at the dock and then starts moving:

- beta19 opens a short departure trust phase;
- old pre-departure far-away candidates cannot replace the dock pose;
- the last trusted real dock pose is held until a pose with a vendor timestamp
  matching the new departure arrives;
- a real pose still physically near the station may update heading/XY without
  ending the departure gate.

This covers both reporter observations in #437:

1. wrong marker briefly on integration startup;
2. wrong marker briefly after starting to mow until actual movement begins.

### Diagnostics

Canonical diagnostics now expose a privacy-safe `health.position_trust` block
with:

- trust phase / ready state;
- first trusted source;
- last decision reason;
- vendor source age;
- station availability and distance only;
- rejected candidate count;
- whether departure gating is active.

Exact mower/station coordinates are not included.

The beta14 `location.report_time` cloud-age correction remains in place.
The beta14 station-as-public-position override remains removed.

No Map Card update is required: null X/Y already hides the mower marker.
